channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: 7 killed and more than 20 injured in Thailand school shooting
item.dc:creator: Joshua Yang
item.description: Authorities say a teen killed his two grandparents and five teachers and staff before taking his own life.

item.title: On Hiroshima anniversary, Japan’s premier shifts tone on nuclear policy
item.dc:creator: Chie Tanaka
item.description: Ultraconservative Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi left a subtle opening in remarks Thursday for rethinking Japan’s “Three Non-Nuclear Principles.”

item.title: Iran says Hormuz deal with Oman won’t fully reopen strait
item.dc:creator: Susannah George
item.description: Oil prices jumped after the comments by senior Iranian officials on the talks to manage traffic through the waterway.

item.title: U.S.-Canada relations go up in smoke
item.dc:creator: Alec Dent
item.description: There’s been something in the air in D.C. this summer — namely wildfire smoke and frustration over Canada’s inability to keep it on its side of the border.
